headline: AGCO Declares Quarterly Dividend of $0.30 Payable in December
summary: Agricultural machinery maker AGCO announced a quarterly dividend of $0.30 per share, payable to shareholders in December.
why: AGCO is a major global manufacturer of agricultural equipment, and its dividend declarations reflect ongoing cash flow health and shareholder return policies.

impacts.name: AGCO
impacts.why: Consistent dividend payouts signal stable operational cash flows to equity investors.
